note: Prototype first 30 seconds only. Remaining song will be built after visual approval.
direction: Premium pink-ink editorial illustration inspired by the supplied romantic poster reference: white paper, hot pink brush typography, hand-drawn mountains, petals, fashion-editorial female portrait, back-facing modern male, Bharatanatyam stage and mudra motifs. Typography is a hero and every visual transition is motivated by lyric meaning.

sequences.concept: Title-card reveal. 'Soneya' brush typography grows over pink mountain linework, petals and the hero couple illustration.
Female editorial portrait and white-saree/chandan motif. Slow camera drift and falling petals.
Stage appears as a luminous theatre frame; dancer enters under a concentrated spotlight as the word 'LIGHT' becomes a ghosted graphic.
Ghungroo become the rhythmic hero object; repeated bells and heartbeat line animate with controlled pulse.
Mudra close-up with editorial vertical annotation; gesture drives typography and hand-drawn ornament.
Expression/bhavam sequence: dancer inside a circular editorial frame with sparse typography and petals.
Modern singer with microphone, graphic frame and handwritten rhyme motif. Visual language deliberately shifts from classical to modern.
Modern boy and Bharatanatyam dancer share the same frame; 'स्वैग' bends toward the dancer and resolves the first 30-second arc.
